description: Byte-discriminating canonicalization cases for DACS fractional-number, safe-magnitude, Unicode-value, and member-name rules.

taggedValueSemantics.binary64: Decode the 16 lowercase hex digits as one IEEE-754 binary64 value.
taggedValueSemantics.bigint: Construct the language's native arbitrary-precision integer type, not a JSON number.
taggedValueSemantics.unicode-code-units: Construct a string from the listed UTF-16 code units, including invalid lone surrogates.

vectors.name: fraction-one-half
vectors.note: A finite fractional JSON number inside the DACS bound is valid.

vectors.name: fraction-one-e-minus-seven
vectors.note: Magnitudes below 1e-6 use ECMAScript scientific notation.

vectors.name: fraction-binary-sum
vectors.note: The shortest round-trippable binary64 digits are preserved.

vectors.name: fraction-one-tenth
vectors.note: A common non-integral metric canonicalizes without coercion.

vectors.name: fraction-negative-one-and-half
vectors.note: The DACS magnitude profile is symmetric around zero.

vectors.name: fixed-notation-lower-threshold
vectors.note: Exactly 1e-6 uses fixed notation.

vectors.name: scientific-notation-below-threshold
vectors.note: The adjacent binary64 below 1e-6 uses scientific notation.

vectors.name: negative-zero
vectors.note: ECMAScript serializes negative zero as 0.

vectors.name: minimum-positive-binary64
vectors.note: Subnormal binary64 values are valid when within the DACS magnitude bound.

vectors.name: minimum-negative-binary64
vectors.note: The minimum negative subnormal retains its sign and shortest exponent form.

vectors.name: integral-binary64-one
vectors.note: An integral binary64 serializes as an integer token without a decimal suffix.

vectors.name: round-to-even
vectors.note: The shortest representation applies ECMAScript's round-to-even rule.

vectors.name: maximum-dacs-magnitude
vectors.note: The inclusive positive DACS magnitude boundary is accepted.

vectors.name: maximum-dacs-magnitude-binary64
vectors.note: The inclusive positive boundary is also accepted through the binary64 path.

vectors.name: minimum-dacs-magnitude-binary64
vectors.note: The inclusive negative boundary is accepted through the binary64 path.

vectors.name: number-over-dacs-magnitude
vectors.note: A number one above the DACS bound must use string carriage.

vectors.name: number-one-e-plus-twenty-one
vectors.note: JCS can encode this value, but the stricter DACS magnitude profile rejects it.

vectors.name: not-a-number
vectors.note: NaN is not a JSON number.

vectors.name: positive-infinity
vectors.note: Infinity is not a JSON number.

vectors.name: bigint-native-type
vectors.note: A native BigInt is not JSON; an adapter must test rejection or abstain explicitly.

vectors.name: nfd-string-value-normalizes-to-nfc
vectors.note: CF-1 normalizes string values before JCS serialization.

vectors.name: nfd-member-name-preserved
vectors.note: CF-1 does not normalize object member names.

vectors.name: nfc-and-nfd-member-names-remain-distinct
vectors.note: Canonical-equivalent member names do not collide and sort as received.

vectors.name: member-name-order-is-utf16
vectors.note: An astral key sorts before U+E000 by UTF-16 code units, not code points.

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-string
vectors.note: Invalid Unicode terminates canonicalization.
